style_metric: Exact rank of numerical scores relative to direct owner preference; ties reported not converted to wins; textual preference secondary; 10 order trials remain only 5 cases.
style_prompt_source: REVIEWER-CALIBRATION/run_style_only.py from prior completed work; unchanged task paragraph, new candidate inputs only
function_metric: Narrow deletion recommendation compared with owner KEEP/CUT, with rationale; historical owner editorial choice not relabeled as proof of semantic equivalence
function_scope: 12 distinct named sections of one guide; avoid independent author claim
selection_rule: Explicit direct owner judgments with recoverable exact excerpts. Five style contrasts (4 from September original five questions; single-only bridge excluded, plus explicit chart-caption preference). Function cases exact H2,H7,H12,H14,H17,H22 plus H4,H10,H19,H21,H25,H28; one per heading, excludes four old calibration pairs, ambiguous/changed owner answers, compound h26/h38 actions, and context-overlapping old test paragraph H31.
fidelity_evaluator_change: Separate recommendation task, protect substantive thought, conditions and rhetorical function; harmless wording can change; count no hidden-source preference. It is a new narrow method, not measured with old mixed score.
isolation: Fresh restricted CLI invocation per trial, no tools, no memory or project settings, label/rationale files never sent, prompt/response hashes retained. Current curator not blind, evaluator is label-blind in input.
stop: Run frozen cases once, all results retained. If reviewer fails calibration, do not tune the same rubric repeatedly on them.
